{{Quote|Omad Kaeg, at your service. ''Captain'' Omad Kaeg, owner and operator of the ''Joyous Roamer'', one of the oldest and most profitable asteroid tugs in the Rift.|Omad Kaeg, to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
An '''asteroid tug''' was a type of [[Spacetug/Legends|tug]] widely used for transporting [[Ore/Legends|ore]] in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]]<ref name="Crucible" /> in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> During the era of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] tug ''[[Joyous Roamer]]'' was among the oldest and most profitable tugs operating in the Rift. As of [[45 ABY]], the tug had been in the family of its owner, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Omad Kaeg]], for more than two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="Crucible" />
{{Ship-stub}}
